purpose: The accessible name of a control as a real label: clicking it focuses or toggles the control it points to. It is the label part of Field, for the rare control that needs a label without Field.

notFor.case: A form control with helper text or an error message.
A checkbox with its label in one row.
A switch with its label in one row.

a11y.keyboard: Not focusable. A click focuses or toggles its control (htmlFor).
notes: Mark required fields in the text, not with colour alone.

openQuestions: Label is code-only, with no Figma set (finding DOC-001 Label). Should it get a Figma set, or stay a code part of Field?
Label has no Disabled state, while Field mutes its label when Disabled. Should Label follow the disabled control?
Usage says to prefer FieldLabel inside a form; FieldLabel is not an Escala component. Is that Field's label prop?
